Emmanuel Carre

Three
homes.
One voice.

237

Born in Cameroon. Raised in France. Based in South Florida. Every stop added another accent, another point of view, and another reason to laugh.

01

The beginning

Emmanuel Carre—better known as Call Me Manny—turns the collisions between cultures, generations, and relationships into fast, physical, high-energy comedy.

02

A new direction

A former collegiate soccer player, Manny found his way to comedy after a heart condition changed the direction of his athletic career. The discipline stayed; the stage became the new pitch.

03

From screen to stage

Characters inspired by African family life, dating, and everyday misunderstandings built a global online audience. Now those stories are becoming a live experience.
